headline: People deposit more than 11.2 quadrillion dong in banks amid wave of high interest rates
summary: Idle cash continues to flow rapidly into Vietnamese credit institutions to take advantage of attractive returns. Total savings deposits have reached an unprecedented record high.
why: Bank deposits are a core funding source for lenders, and their growth shapes credit supply and the cost of money in the economy.
